cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
You need to validate based on constraints here, see https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcount-constraints , https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode : if the channel count mode is Max or the channel count is greater than two, return a NotSupported Error

You'll also need to add similar constraints on SetChannelCount and SetChannelCountMode on audionode.rs
